title: Query strings and wildcards for a router
prompt: app.js already registers routes that router.js can't handle yet. Extend router.js so that: match() ignores the query string when matching and returns it parsed as `query` (an object; the empty object when there is none); a pattern can end in `*`, which matches one or more remaining segments and puts them, joined by '/', in params.rest; and a trailing slash on the path makes no difference. Everything that works today must keep working.
